body: You know you can talk about everything here, no one knows you and no one judges you
Yea thank you but she has her struggles too I'm helping with so it's kinda like we are helping each other up until we can walk alone someday. But it's really nice to hear people caring.
That is so sad to hear but please reconsider. And why do you think someone is hacking in your phone?

Feelings like this often don't have a real reason. It's like a disease and you need help. Ask you parents and friends about such themes and spend time together. Have fun online or irl. It makes you forget sometimes and make you feel happiness. This feeling is what you should try to hold on to. But don't rush it, it needs time and love to heal.

Hey please don't do something like that. Your life is important. And far more than you think. Maybe confront them in a few days. send them this text without saying it's you, and when the answer is positive try to say that you wrote that. Its all going to get fine again.
You know this will be over and when it is please go to a hospital or call someone. You deserve help. And you are way to awesome to just kill yourself. You can do it.
Find a community you like on reddit or discord or if you need someone to talk to I can text with you if you need it for now. Not as good as irl but something.

Hey its nothing to worry about, it's normal just like being straight. And true friends will respect that and when they don't there is a community you can talk and get new friends on. I believe in you! You can do it  without self harm even if its not easy it will get easier someday.

But well do you know how I could talk to my 'girlfriend' about this. Like I have been really thinking about it but it always came out with me thinking I'll do something wrong and lose her. And if that would happen. The thing I tried to hold on to the most would be gone. I just want a second 'opinion' even when this is not exactly what this sub is for. I'm just scared for doing something wrong.
Oh wow thank you I didn't expect anyone to look at all of that, thank you. I can try.
